content.rendered: Archer Glen incoming Kindergarteners have the opportunity to meet the Kinder teachers and make new friends on Tuesday, July 20th from 6 pm – 8 pm at Archer Glen under the back covered play area. This is a time for families to meet and for our newest students to become more comfortable with our outdoor setting. The teachers will be available to answer questions and get acquainted with your children. Snacks and water will be provided.
